segments.command: village/force senior command and mission authority
segments.field_shinobi: ordinary serving shinobi who share professional rumor/report networks
segments.intelligence: intelligence, ANBU/counterintelligence, analysts, and restricted briefing circles when lawfully connected
segments.civilian_public: ordinary civilian public in a settlement/land
segments.clan_internal: members of a specific clan/house internal network
segments.underworld: criminal, bounty, broker, missing-nin, and illicit information networks
segments.foreign_intelligence: a specific foreign village/state intelligence audience, never a generic omniscient enemy
segments.mission_clients: clients/employers who lawfully receive mission outcome information

rules: Audience membership/knowledge is resolved from current institution, role, location, information access, and saved social links.
Do not create a world-public audience that automatically knows all public events.
One person may participate in multiple audiences; use only audiences they can actually access.
